notes: *on* is placed on the verb because the Hebrew object רוּחַ carries neither an object marker nor a preposition of its own (rule 44), matching verse 16 and contrasting with verse 18.
Both בִּקְנֵה הַמִּדָּה phrases are split by rule 2: the article takes the written *the* standing before its own word and the rectum the attributive *measuring* (rules 29, 28).
